## fingerprint

```yaml
what_it_is: 'Trains a (smaller) student to match a frozen teacher''s outputs, features,
  or relations alongside the task objective.

  '
positive_signals:
- a frozen teacher and a trained student
- a temperature-scaled soft-target / feature-matching loss
- feature, attention-map, or relation matching between teacher and student
route_elsewhere:
- signal: the paper contributes only the backbone architecture, not a teacher/student
    transfer objective
  to: TE-AR/vision_transformer
- signal: the method adapts across domains with pseudo-labels rather than distilling
    from a fixed teacher
  to: DA-UDA/domain_adaptation
worked_examples:
- Hinton et al. 2015 (response KD)
- FitNets (Romero et al. 2014)
- Attention Transfer (Zagoruyko & Komodakis 2016)
```
